summary: Compared the product-bundle-overview reference, rendered and diff crops with the frozen source typography/content and current geometry. The outer section geometry passes at x/y +1 px with exact width and height, but the internal commerce presentation is materially different (14.870% crop mismatch).
issues:
PB-OVERVIEW-001 | priority: critical | property: product typography and internal layout | expected: 48 px bold two-line title, readable 16 px metadata/component rows, 20 px bundle heading and source-sized pricing/actions | actual: title is visibly smaller/lighter, metadata contains literal '
', bundle rows are compressed into undersized text and large empty space remains | fix: restore the source typography and internal row geometry while rendering line breaks as markup rather than escaped text.

PB-OVERVIEW-002 | priority: high | property: bundle item media and row composition | expected: Pixafen and Spark bottle images with quantity, description, current price and struck old price aligned as two distinct rows | actual: product images are absent and quantity/description/price columns are compressed and partly collide | fix: render the exact source-backed product media and restore source row sizing/alignment.

PB-OVERVIEW-003 | priority: critical | property: price block | expected: 'Cena:' plus prominent green 2 965,00 zł, adjacent '(w tym 23% VAT)', with the former price presented separately as sourced | actual: 3.365,00 zł and 2.965,00 zł appear as same-size underlined text, the source label, green emphasis and VAT text are missing | fix: map native regular/sale/tax data into the source price hierarchy and formatting.

PB-OVERVIEW-004 | priority: high | property: controls and metadata | expected: minus/value/plus quantity stepper, cart icon/button, rating row, wholesale contact line and favorite line with source icons | actual: only a plain quantity input is shown, rating/favorite rows are absent, and the wholesale message is an unrelated orange pill | fix: restore the source-backed controls/icons and visual states without faking business actions.
